notes: Hex fields are raw bytes. *_base64 fields are standard base64; fragments are base64url without padding.
fragment starts with the share kind byte and burn_fragment with the burn kind byte; each must be refused where the other is expected.
Encryption tests must use the manifest string exactly as given, not re-serialise it.
Argon2 memory (m) is in KiB. pass_key is the 32-byte Argon2id output.
Decryption tests must recover text and files exactly; reject cases must fail with the error named in expect (server: the length check refuses the blob before any client sees it).
reject_fragments must be refused by a decoder asked for the kind in `as`, with the error named in expect.

inputs.text: Two attachments. Second file name is UTF-8. 🔐

expected.manifest: {"v":1,"text":"Two attachments. Second file name is UTF-8. 🔐","files":[{"name":"notes.txt","type":"text/plain","size":18},{"name":"résumé.png","type":"image/png","size":1208}]}

reject.name: tag-tampered
reject.reason: last chunk tag fails to authenticate

reject.name: wrapped-ek-tampered
reject.reason: wrapped_EK fails to unwrap in direct mode; the client would prompt for a passphrase that does not exist

reject.name: truncated
reject.reason: length matches no valid padded size; the server refuses it and the client's final chunk fails to authenticate

reject.name: header-too-short
reject.reason: shorter than the 95-byte header

reject.name: header-only
reject.reason: a header with no chunks at all

reject.name: argon-m-below-bounds
reject.reason: m outside the client bound

reject.name: argon-m-above-bounds
reject.reason: m outside the client bound

reject.name: argon-t-below-bounds
reject.reason: t outside the client bound

reject.name: argon-t-above-bounds
reject.reason: t outside the client bound

reject.name: argon-p-below-bounds
reject.reason: p outside the client bound

reject.name: argon-p-above-bounds
reject.reason: p outside the client bound

reject.name: last-flag-missing
reject.reason: the final chunk was sealed without the last flag, so it fails to authenticate as the final chunk; this is how a truncated stream is detected

reject.name: chunks-out-of-order
reject.reason: chunk 1 presented first fails to authenticate under index 0

reject.name: last-flag-on-middle-chunk
reject.reason: chunk 0 carries the last flag although a chunk follows

reject.name: last-chunk-missing
reject.reason: the length is a valid padded size, but the only chunk was sealed as a middle chunk, so it fails as the final one

reject.name: truncated-mid-chunk
reject.reason: cut inside the final chunk; the length matches no padded size

reject.name: short-final-fragment
reject.reason: the final sealed chunk is shorter than a tag

reject.name: payload-len-too-large
reject.reason: payload_len exceeds bucket - 4; reject after decryption

reject.name: payload-len-too-large-multi-chunk
reject.reason: payload_len exceeds bucket - 4 on a two-chunk blob

reject.name: payload-len-zero
reject.reason: an empty payload cannot hold a manifest length

reject.name: manifest-len-over-1mib
reject.reason: manifest_len above 1 MiB

reject.name: manifest-len-past-payload
reject.reason: manifest_len reaches past the payload

reject.name: manifest-invalid-utf8
reject.reason: manifest is not UTF-8

reject.name: manifest-wrong-version
reject.reason: unknown manifest version

reject.name: manifest-not-an-object
reject.reason: manifest is not a JSON object

reject.name: manifest-zero-files-null-text
reject.reason: neither text nor a file

reject.name: file-size-too-large
reject.reason: file size reaches past the payload

reject.name: file-size-too-small
reject.reason: bytes left over after the last file

reject.name: file-size-negative
reject.reason: negative file size

reject.name: file-size-fractional
reject.reason: fractional file size

reject.name: file-entry-null
reject.reason: a file entry that is not an object

reject.name: file-entry-missing-name
reject.reason: a file entry without a name

reject.name: manifest-bom
reject.reason: a UTF-8 byte order mark before the JSON

reject.name: manifest-duplicate-key
reject.reason: a duplicated key; lenient parsers would keep one of the two values

reject.name: manifest-non-integer-number
reject.reason: 1.0 is not the integer 1

reject.name: manifest-lone-surrogate
reject.reason: a lone surrogate escape is not a Unicode string

reject.name: manifest-missing-text
